Using the focus-directrix property, the directrix is \(x=-1\), so for \(M=(t^2,2t)\) on \(y^2=4x\),
\[
|MF|=t^2+1.
\]
Also
\[
|MP|=\sqrt{(t^2-3)^2+(2t-1)^2}.
\]
Thus minimize
\[
f(t)=\sqrt{(t^2-3)^2+(2t-1)^2}+t^2+1.
\]
Differentiate and set \(f'(t)=0\):
\[
t\sqrt{(t^2-3)^2+(2t-1)^2}=1+t-t^3.
\]
Squaring gives
\[
2t^3-9t^2+2t+1=0
\]
with valid root \(t=\frac12\). Hence \(M=(\frac14,1)\), and
\[
|MP|+|MF|=\frac{11}{4}+\frac54=4.
\]
\[
\boxed{4}
\]
